battleVictory.238: Oh you're good! You might just have a shot, here are some Beast Balls. Go hunt down those strange Ultra Beasts! If you need more Beast Balls, you can buy them here.
battleVictory.240: I had to be sure. Sure that you're ready for what's coming...
battleVictory.241: Thanks for battling with me again! I've reignited my passion to battle after a nice, long break! ....Did one of the Pikachu here steal my Pikachu's hat? Oh well. I have spares. It'll be somewhere around here if you want it.
battleVictory.242: Hmph! I'll have you know defeating me won't do you any good, anyway.
battleVictory.243: You've made your point. I can see you are not one to be trifled with.
battleVictory.244: I fell behind, but only by an inch.
battleVictory.245: I can feel the fire of your convictions burning deep within your heart!
battleVictory.246: I couldn't have been defeated by some random Trainer from who knows where!
battleVictory.247: Ha! That was a truly intense fight!
battleVictory.248: Your scales are full of heart!
battleVictory.249: Wow, you're the cream of the 'karp, alright!
battleVictory.250: Are you sure your Karp isn't flying-type?
battleVictory.251: I lost because of my karpal tunnel...
battleVictory.252: Basculin the glory while you can, I'll get you next time! Wahaa!
battleVictory.254: Hey, would you mind letting minnow when you want to rematch?
battleVictory.256: Magikarp is so classy, it's so-fish-ticated
battleVictory.257: That battle scared the karp out of me!
battleVictory.258: I will jump away from this battle!
battleVictory.259: Are you trying to fly to the stratosphere?
battleVictory.261: I wish a Pidgeotto would steal me away about now...
battleVictory.262: Wow, you've been drinking your Training Sodas!
battleVictory.263: I need to find more sunken treasures...
battleVictory.264: You cheater! I have seen Rowlet giving you money!!!
battleVictory.265: My Magikarp might not jump high but it's fast enough to win the Naskarp Cup.
battleVictory.266: I will beat you next time! Any fin is possible if you believe in it!
battleVictory.267: Who wants to place a bait on a rematch?
battleVictory.268: The way my Magikarp performed is a-trout-cious!
battleVictory.269: Well, that was a shock! Guess I know now why Lee thought he should give you a Pokémon, too...
battleVictory.271: And I even got my Pokéball throw perfect too!
battleVictory.272: Was that really good training? Looks like I'd better keep my guard up!
battleVictory.273: I see... Well, that's fine. I wasn't really trying all that hard anyway.
battleVictory.274: We both got ourselves the same Grass Badge, so how come you're so much stronger?
battleVictory.275: You showed at least a little effort, so I decided I should let you win!
battleVictory.276: You beat me... Guess you must not be so bad after all, huh?
battleVictory.277: My strategy goes right to pot when I've got all these bad thoughts running through my head...
battleVictory.278: This has to be some kind of mistake. I demand a do-over!
battleVictory.279: This is rubbish... My team can't perform if I can't get my own head straight as their Trainer...
battleVictory.280: I still can't even beat you, my true rival... But I think I'm starting to see the light!
battleVictory.281: What's with that?! My Pokémon didn't get a chance to really do their thing at all. Ugh!
battleVictory.282: You defeated Eternatus, but it looks like it's not over yet!
battleVictory.284: I didn't expect there to be such a gap between you and me, mate...
battleVictory.285: Oh... How can this be? My...my Pokémon...
battleVictory.289: Quite the vexing predicament indeed, surely this must be some kind of mistake...
battleVictory.292: Thank you for the battle. I can now accept you as the Champion. It's painful to admit, but I've come to realise a few of my weaknesses. But I'll keep getting stronger. I'll reach the pinnacle of what Fairy types can do.
battleVictory.295: Yeah I lost, but I'm gonna learn from your battle style and everythin'!
battleVictory.300: Oh, my next Pokémon's gonna make short work-- Huh? That was my last one?
battleVictory.302: That was everything I hoped for and more!
battleVictory.303: Just what have you got that I don't?
battleVictory.304: What a Psystrike to my poor pride...
battleVictory.305: But I didn't hold back! I gave it everything I've got...
battleVictory.306: Oh, I should just Imprison myself for this!
battleVictory.308: ...I really thought I could beat you this time. Still, it was a really fun battle! Okay, let's go to Glimwood Tangle! I'll beat you there!
battleVictory.311: Gahahaaa! Look at me, takin' a thrashin' from a youngster like you!
battleVictory.314: The legendary birds fled in different directions.
battleVictory.315: Galarian Articuno fled to elsewhere in the Crown Tundra.
battleVictory.316: Galarian Zapdos fled to elsewhere in the Wild Area.
battleVictory.317: Galarian Moltres fled to elsewhere in the Isle of Armor.
battleVictory.319: Defeated again, Eternatus fled far to the south!
battleVictory.320: Moves, items... Use them well, and the world will open up to you!
battleVictory.321: You and your Pokémon seem completely in step with one another.
battleVictory.322: You really aren't one of the usual Galaxy buffoons if you could defeat my partner... Well fought, Munchlax.
battleVictory.325: I see now... Poké Balls are simply your tool of choice, not products of disregard for Pokémon. You still understand the Pokémon and trust them as partners. I feel better putting my trust in you now, I think.
battleVictory.326: The golden light was dispelled from Kleavor, calming it.
battleVictory.327: Oops! I keep finding myself caught up in observing the way the Pokémon use their moves...
battleVictory.328: Oh, my! You're quite adept at instructing your Pokémon in battle! My goodness, that was fun!
battleVictory.329: I'm not fond of this outcome, but at least it's still better than plowing fields for the Galaxy Team!
battleVictory.331: The golden light was dispelled from Lilligant, calming it.
battleVictory.332: Ah, now I feel better! The world is vast...and I am small within it.
battleVictory.333: I don't get it! How'd I lose?!
battleVictory.334: What a blithering mooncalf I am. How could I let myself lose...
battleVictory.336: The golden light was dispelled from Arcanine, calming it.
battleVictory.337: You see how good they are now, yes? No more sneering at them!
battleVictory.338: Listen here! Neither I nor Skuntank admit defeat to you just yet-our challenge to you still stands!
battleVictory.339: Bravo! Excellent! Your talent has brought you to the destination called Victory! Now, allow me to call Sneasler...
battleVictory.340: Let's make one thing clear: I didn't lose! You may have won...but there's a difference!
battleVictory.341: The golden light was dispelled from Electrode, calming it.
battleVictory.342: Outstanding! I'm tough as an iceberg, but you smashed me through and through!
battleVictory.343: Wow, you caught us AND you beat us. You've won all our games so far! But Braviary still wants to get to know you even better. Up to the roof we go! All right, Braviary! Why not test out their strength for yourself?
battleVictory.345: The golden light was dispelled from Avalugg, calming it.
battleVictory.346: It seems my ninja techniques will soon be consigned to history...
battleVictory.348: Dialga was captured in the Origin Ball and returned to its base form!
battleVictory.349: Palkia was captured in the Origin Ball and returned to its base form!
battleVictory.350: Even frightful creatures like Pokémon can become powerful allies...
battleVictory.351: You're really something...and I'm a man of my word. So, here's that treasure.
battleVictory.352: I wonder... Are there people even stronger than you out in the world, with Pokémon stronger than yours? I'll just have to find out for myself I suppose! Here! The treasure I promised you.
battleVictory.353: Turning tail and running? From this puny HUMAN? Pathetic! I was the one to feed you the power you needed so that you could take on Arceus! I was the one who gave you the chance to claw open that space-time rift, driving the deity of space and time mad so that you could drag the creator out from hiding!
battleVictory.354: Before you could attempt to capture it, Enamorus fled to roam the region!
battleVictory.355: Arceus granted you a part of its self, and the Legend Plate!

zCrystalTrial.Normal.prefix: What an incredible Trainer you are! The Z-Crystal from the pedestal is yours now! It is known as Normalium Z!
zCrystalTrial.Normal.full: What an incredible Trainer you are! The Z-Crystal from the pedestal is yours now! It is known as Normalium Z!
zCrystalTrial.Flying.prefix: Hello there. There's a wonderful breeze blowing out here today. The glistening Flyinium Z... It's yours now. Use it well.
zCrystalTrial.Flying.full: Hello there. There's a wonderful breeze blowing out here today. The glistening Flyinium Z... It's yours now. Use it well.
zCrystalTrial.Water.prefix: Very well done! You do know what this is, don't you? Please take this Waterium Z.
zCrystalTrial.Water.full: Very well done! You do know what this is, don't you? Please take this Waterium Z.
zCrystalTrial.Fire.prefix: Whoa! S-spectacular! That Pokémon was protecting this Firium Z. Now it is yours.
zCrystalTrial.Fire.full: Whoa! S-spectacular! That Pokémon was protecting this Firium Z. Now it is yours.
zCrystalTrial.Grass.prefix: Wow, you're even stronger than I thought! Looks like you've cleared all three of Akala's trials! Here! A gift for such an inspiring young Trainer!
zCrystalTrial.Grass.full: Wow, you're even stronger than I thought! Looks like you've cleared all three of Akala's trials! Here! A gift for such an inspiring young Trainer!
zCrystalTrial.Electric.prefix: That Pokémon was really something else! Here, I'll give you this Electrium Z to reward you for beating it.
zCrystalTrial.Electric.full: That Pokémon was really something else! Here, I'll give you this Electrium Z to reward you for beating it.
zCrystalTrial.Ghost.prefix: Welcome back! Now let's see how you did... Yup! You passed my trial! Here you go!
zCrystalTrial.Ghost.full: Welcome back! Now let's see how you did... Yup! You passed my trial! Here you go!

zCrystalTrial.Bug.full: There is a chest full of Bug-type Z-Crystals next to Guzma. You obtained a Buginium Z!
zCrystalTrial.Dragon.prefix: <i>You obtained a Dragon-Type Z-Crystal. The Dragonium Z is yours!<i>
zCrystalTrial.Dragon.full: You obtained a Dragon-Type Z-Crystal. The Dragonium Z is yours!
zCrystalTrial.Fairy.prefix: That's a pretty great picture. You and your Pokémon! You're a great Pokémon Trainer! So here you go! A piece of Fairium Z for you!
zCrystalTrial.Fairy.full: That's a pretty great picture. You and your Pokémon! You're a great Pokémon Trainer! So here you go! A piece of Fairium Z for you!

sootCollector.0: Blegh! I've taken three soaks in the hot springs and I can still taste the soot!
sootCollector.1: The Flute Trader in Fallarbor Town has been paying me to go collect soot to make Flutes, but I'm sick of it.
sootCollector.2: People say they have truly mystical powers, but that they require Gems of different types to use. Also, using more Flutes at the same time costs more Gems to use.
